title: Neural Tracking to go
description: A mobile EEG dataset of auditory attention recorded from 20 participants. Using a two-competing-speaker paradigm, participants either sat on a chair or walked a route indoors while attending to one of the speakers. Attention was disrupted by salient environmental events presented from in front of the participant, allowing the study of neural tracking of speech under realistic, mobile conditions.
methods_description: Mobile EEG was recorded from 20 participants (24 EEG channels) during a two-competing-speaker auditory attention task, performed while sitting or walking a route indoors. Salient environmental events from in front of the participant served as attention disruptors.
